part.text:
Done. Implemented the DSL in `src/lib.rs` — all 9 tests in `tests/dot-dsl.rs` pass and clippy is clean.

The implementation uses the builder pattern throughout:

- **`Graph`** (`src/lib.rs`) — holds public `nodes: Vec<Node>`, `edges: Vec<Edge>`, and `attrs: HashMap<String, String>`. Builder methods `with_nodes`, `with_edges`, and `with_attrs` take `&self`, clone the graph, apply the change, and return the new value, so calls chain fluently. Also has `node(name)` to look up a node by name.
- **`Node`** (`graph::graph_items::node`) — a named node with a private `attrs` map; `new(name)`, `with_attrs(&[(&str, &str)])`, and `attr(name) -> Option<&str>`.
- **`Edge`** (`graph::graph_items::edge`) — `from`/`to` endpoints with the same attribute API.

Both item types derive `Debug, Clone, PartialEq` since the tests compare them with `assert_eq!`.

Note: the tests are marked `#[ignore]` (exercism convention — you un-ignore them as you solve), so I verified with `cargo test -- --include-ignored`.
